title: Dream Studio - skill mode card
description: The dream_studio frontmatter block of a mode's SKILL.md. Uniform across every carded mode by convention since the pack split; this file makes that convention checkable. write_posture and lifecycle are the two fields the convention lacked: capabilities_required says whether a mode CAN write, not whether it may write unattended, and nothing recorded whether a mode is current or superseded.

skill_id.description: The invocable skill surface, e.g. ds-quality.

mode.description: Directory name under the pack's modes/, and the mode argument.

inputs.description: Vocabulary tokens this mode consumes. Each is produced by another mode's outputs, or registered as a root input in canonical/skill_vocabulary.json.

capabilities_required.description: Harness tools the mode needs. A capability is what the mode CAN reach; write_posture is what it may do with it unattended.

model_preference.description: Default tier. Resolved through config/skill_profiles.py, which lets an operator override it without editing this card.

write_posture.description: read-only: observes and reports, changes nothing. independent: makes reversible changes inside the work boundary without asking. hitl: reaches a step the operator approves before it takes effect - a deploy, a merge, a delivery that leaves the machine.

lifecycle.description: published: routable and current. deprecated: still resolvable, superseded - it stays listed so an existing invocation keeps working while callers move.
